facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation, with the Ministry of Public Administration and Political Affairs, the HRMO and the Public Service Academy, is running Cohort 1 of a digital skills training programme for civil servants, with a new cohort to follow.
TechReviewAfrica reports the training targets staff across ministries, departments and agencies.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation

SLE.note: The programme described is for civil servants only.
